summary: Sunstone is a verified active Mexico City-based renewable-development platform. CIP and GMF II are directly verified at the underlying La Esperanza project, which reached financial close and construction with a CFE Calificados PPA, but no direct disclosure or legal record proves CIP owns Sunstone itself or establishes a 2023 platform entry, stake or committed equity. Retain Sunstone, keep its entities and projects subordinate, and defer the direct manager ownership judgment.
unresolvedDisclosureGaps: The registered members, founders and ultimate beneficial owners of Sunstone Power and Sunstone Power 2 are not publicly resolved.
No source proves a CIP or GMF II platform equity stake, vehicle, entry date or committed capital.
